item.title: SpaceXAI Releases Grok 4.6 With Focus on Long-Running Agent Workflows
item.summary: SpaceXAI released Grok 4.6, a post-training upgrade scoring 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — tying GPT-5.6 Sol Max — with a 500,000-token context window and agentic reinforcement learning designed for long-running autonomous workflows.
